import pandas as pd

ORDERS_FILE = "orders.csv"
ITEMS_FILE = "order_items.csv"
QUARTERS = ["2024Q4", "2025Q3", "2025Q4"]


def load_orders(orders_file, items_file):
    items = pd.read_csv(items_file)
    orders = pd.read_csv(orders_file, parse_dates=["order_date"])
    items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])
    revenue = items.groupby("order_id", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum()
    return orders.merge(revenue, on="order_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one")


def quarter_summary(df, quarter):
    """Return a dict with keys quarter, revenue, orders, aov for one quarter
    (non-cancelled orders only), revenue and aov rounded to 2 decimals.
    Assert that the quarter has at least one order."""
    kept = df[df["status"] != "cancelled"]
    in_q = kept[kept["order_date"].dt.to_period("Q") == quarter]
    assert len(in_q) > 0, f"no orders in {quarter}"
    return {
        "quarter": quarter,
        "revenue": round(in_q["revenue"].sum(), 2),
        "orders": len(in_q),
        "aov": round(in_q["revenue"].mean(), 2),
    }


df = load_orders(ORDERS_FILE, ITEMS_FILE)

summary = pd.DataFrame([quarter_summary(df, q) for q in QUARTERS])
summary.to_csv("quarter_summary.csv", index=False)
print(summary)
